## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Target branch is `dev`; the change is focused.
- [ ] Relevant tests and both package builds pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] User-facing docs/translations are updated in all four languages where affected.
- [ ] Third-party notices are preserved; generated files and personal device data are excluded.
